text: v0.114.29 is built (install this for manual bets): https://github.com/tjshea90/novig/releases/tag/v0.114.29 . If you were on an older build, that explains the repeat. Since 'it never happened before' points at Novig changing something, I'm also making the app treat any order status other than PENDING/OPEN as finished (if Novig now says something like EXPIRED or CANCELLED, the app was waiting forever). That goes out as the next version; v0.114.30 (Live button fix) is in its gate now.
